basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old automotive enthusiast and professional detailer based in San Diego, California. I've been in the auto detailing business for over a decade and specialize in high-end ceramic coatings and paint corrections. Besides my work, I have a passion for fly fishing and often spend weekends at nearby lakes. I'm usually online during late evenings after work hours. I'm currently single and enjoy my independence, allowing me to pursue my hobbies and interests freely. I love ASMR content, which helps me relax after a long day.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong foundation in auto detailing, gained through years of hands-on experience and continuous learning. I started my career as an apprentice at a local detailing shop and gradually built my own client base. I frequently attend workshops and seminars to stay updated on the latest techniques and products. My knowledge extends to both practical application and the business side of auto detailing.
